data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Google Navigation and map widgets on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides Google Maps navigation and map view widgets for Flutter apps. Handles turn-by-turn navigation sessions, destination routing with route tokens, and map styling.
use_when: You need to build turn-by-turn GPS navigation into your app.
You want to display Google Maps with integrated navigation functionality.
avoid_when: You only need basic static maps without turn-by-turn navigation requirements.
You cannot meet the strict native requirements (iOS 17.0+, Android API 24+, and Google Cloud project with billing).
strengths: Official Google Navigation SDK bindings for Flutter.
Supports both Android and iOS platforms.
Includes features for route tokens, notifications, and custom display options.
weaknesses: Requires a Google Cloud project with billing and specific API restrictions/keys.
High minimum setup requirements such as iOS 17.0+ and specific Gradle/AGP versions on Android.
Beta software status means breaking changes may occur.
data.setup_notes: Requires a Google Cloud project, API keys configured for both Android and iOS, Swift Package Manager on iOS, core library desugaring on Android, background mode permissions, and specific SDK/Gradle versions.
